We serve all individuals, with a specialization in working with LGBTQ2IA+ individuals and people who have experienced trauma. We also support the broader LGBTQ2IA+ community through partnerships with organizations to improve care for gender and sexuality-expansive individuals.

Golden Psychology exists to empower and affirm LGBTQ2IA+ individuals through compassionate, trauma-informed care and innovative therapies, challenging systems of oppression and advocating for a world that values every person’s whole self. We strive to revolutionize mental health care for LGBTQ2IA+ individuals by researching affirming, cutting-edge therapies and by supporting clinicians who share our vision of inclusivity, dignity, and transformative healing. We work with organizations and institutions to foster inclusive, trauma-informed environments, helping them develop policies, training, and systems that respect and support gender and sexuality-diverse individuals. Our mission is to empower our partners to create lasting, affirming change, ensuring that LGBTQ2IA+ people feel seen, valued, and safe in every space.
Our Approach
• Offer affirming DBT, trauma therapy, and Ketamine Assisted Psychotherapy.
• Train and support clinicians in the provision of affirming care.
• Engage with systems to improve access to affirming care.
• Collaborate with organizations to support gender and sexuality-affirming care.

rows.business_description:
Fix It With Piggy is the Bronx’s only full-service community tech hub, providing both high-quality technology services and accessible tech education for youth, adults, and local organizations. Founded by Ashonda Culcleasure, Fix It With Piggy was created to close the digital divide in underserved communities by offering a safe, vibrant, and culturally responsive space where people of all ages can learn, work, and engage with technology confidently.

We operate as a hybrid service and education model. Our tech service department offers device diagnostics, hardware repair, software troubleshooting, data recovery, website development, and on-demand tech support for individuals, families, and small businesses. These services provide reliable, affordable solutions for community members who often lack access to trustworthy tech repair options. Revenue from services directly funds our educational programming and workforce development opportunities.

Our education division delivers hands-on, project-based learning through after-school programs, weekend workshops, summer internships, and adult digital literacy classes. Students learn skills such as computer repair, coding, web design, digital creativity, and AI fluency—skills that translate into confidence, academic improvement, and career readiness. Many of our youth participants leave with certificates, completed digital projects, laptops, mentorship, and pathways toward employment. Our programs are intentionally designed to uplift Bronx youth by providing exposure to STEM, 21st-century job skills, and real-world tech experience.

Fix It With Piggy also serves local schools, nonprofits, and community centers through partnerships that deliver tech curriculum, teacher professional development, and on-site tech support. Our commitment to community advancement extends to job creation; we regularly hire interns, high school seniors, and college students, offering paid work experiences that help them build professional portfolios and secure future employment.

At the core of our mission is the belief that technology should be empowering, not intimidating or inaccessible. Fix It With Piggy transforms learning by making tech fun, hands-on, and culturally connected, while simultaneously solving everyday tech problems for the neighborhood. What began as a mission-driven startup has grown into a trusted Bronx institution dedicated to digital equity, economic mobility, and community innovation.

Fix It With Piggy is preparing to launch its first full community tech hub space, located inside the historic Andrew Freedman Home. The space will operate as a tech café, training center, repair shop, and creative studio, offering youth and adults a place to learn, build, repair, collaborate, and earn.

Our long-term vision is to build a replicable model of community-based tech empowerment across New York City and beyond—bridging digital gaps while cultivating the next generation of tech talent right here in the Bronx.

rows.business_description:
Laurissa Jane Music Studio (LJMS) is a dedicated performing arts institution committed to providing children, youth, and adults with a strong, equitable foundation in music and the performing arts. Rooted in community engagement and artistic excellence, LJMS believes in the transformative power of arts education to build confidence, discipline, creativity, and lifelong skills.

LJMS proudly serves the vibrant communities of South Jamaica, St. Albans, Hollis, Queens Village, Rosedale, and Cambria Heights in Queens—areas where access to consistent, high-quality arts programming is often limited. To further remove geographic barriers, LJMS also offers live, interactive online instruction, allowing students in Brooklyn and beyond to participate fully in our programs. Through our virtual offerings, LJMS has successfully reached students as far as Oregon and Georgia, expanding access to arts education for families nationwide.

Through a team of experienced, professionally trained instructors, LJMS provides both private and group instruction, offered in person and online, in piano, voice, guitar, choral music, and musical theater. Instruction is available for students of all ages and skill levels, from early childhood beginners to teens and adults pursuing advanced musical goals. Lessons are designed to be sequential and developmentally appropriate, emphasizing technical proficiency, music literacy, ensemble skills, and expressive performance while fostering creativity and self-confidence.

LJMS places a strong emphasis on inclusive, student-centered learning environments. Group classes promote collaboration, teamwork, and peer learning, while private instruction allows for individualized goal-setting and personalized musical development. Across all programs, instructors integrate foundational musicianship, performance practice, and social-emotional learning, helping students build resilience, focus, and communication skills through the arts.

In addition to year-round music instruction, LJMS operates a Summer Musical Theatre Arts Program, which offers a dynamic, immersive creative environment for young people with a passion for acting, singing, and dancing. This multidisciplinary program integrates vocal performance, acting technique, movement, choreography, and ensemble collaboration. Students work together toward a culminating production, gaining firsthand experience in rehearsal processes, stage presence, and live performance while developing leadership and confidence in a supportive setting.

Recognizing the importance of formal music education and credentialing, LJMS offers year-round preparation for nationally and internationally recognized music assessments, including NYSSMA and ABRSM. Through structured coaching, repertoire development, and mock evaluations, students are supported in achieving measurable milestones that strengthen academic portfolios and artistic pathways.

Performance is a central component of LJMS programming. Students are provided with regular opportunities to perform in recitals, showcases, school partnerships, and community events, allowing them to apply their learning in real-world settings and engage families and community members in their artistic growth. These experiences reinforce confidence, accountability, and pride in achievement.

Grounded in the belief that the arts are essential—not optional—LJMS remains committed to expanding access to high-quality music and performing arts education. By combining in-person and online instruction, community-based partnerships, and performance-driven learning, Laurissa Jane Music Studio continues to nurture the next generation of expressive, skilled, and empowered artists while strengthening the cultural fabric of the communities it serves.

rows.business_description:
BrainBridge is a pioneering education company dedicated to transforming the learning experiences of students across New York City. Our mission is to bridge the gap between traditional education and the evolving needs of the modern world through innovative, personalized, and technology-driven solutions.

Mission and Vision:
At BrainBridge, we envision a future where every student has access to high-quality education tailored to their unique needs and learning styles. Our mission is to empower students to achieve their fullest potential by providing cutting-edge educational resources, comprehensive support services, and fostering an inclusive and engaging learning environment.

Services Offered:

Personalized Learning Programs:

Customized tutoring sessions designed to meet the specific needs of each student.
Development of individualized learning plans based on thorough assessments.
Utilization of adaptive learning technologies to enhance student engagement and outcomes.

STEM Education:

Specialized programs focused on Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics.
Hands-on learning experiences and projects to foster critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Collaboration with schools and community centers to promote STEM education in underserved areas.
College and Career Readiness:

Comprehensive college advising services, including application assistance, essay writing workshops, and interview preparation.
Career counseling and skills development workshops to prepare students for the workforce.
Partnerships with local businesses and organizations to provide internship and apprenticeship opportunities.
Professional Development for Educators:

Training programs for teachers and administrators to integrate technology and innovative teaching methods in their classrooms.
Workshops and seminars on best practices in education, classroom management, and student engagement.
Ongoing support and coaching to help educators implement new strategies effectively.
Family Engagement Programs:

Initiatives to strengthen family-school partnerships, based on the Dual Capacity-Building Framework.
Workshops and resources for parents to support their children's academic and personal development.
Community events and activities to foster a collaborative and supportive educational community.
Innovation and Technology:
BrainBridge leverages the latest in educational technology to enhance learning experiences. Our online platform offers a range of digital resources, interactive lessons, and virtual tutoring sessions, ensuring that students have access to quality education anytime, anywhere. We are committed to staying at the forefront of educational innovation, continuously exploring new tools and methods to improve student outcomes.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:
As a Minority and Women-owned Business Enterprise (MWBE), BrainBridge is dedicated to promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion in education. We actively work to create a welcoming and inclusive environment for all students, regardless of their background. Our programs are designed to address the unique challenges faced by students from underserved communities, ensuring that every child has the opportunity to succeed.

Community Impact:
BrainBridge is deeply committed to making a positive impact in our community. We partner with local schools, community organizations, and other stakeholders to identify and address the educational needs of our community. Our initiatives aim to close the achievement gap, promote lifelong learning, and contribute to the overall well-being and prosperity of our community.

Future Goals:
Looking ahead, BrainBridge aims to expand our reach and impact by:

Launching new programs and services to address emerging educational needs.
Building stronger partnerships with schools, businesses, and community organizations.
Continuing to innovate and integrate new technologies to enhance our offerings.
Scaling our operations to serve a broader student population across New York City and beyond.
Conclusion:
BrainBridge is committed to revolutionizing education through innovation, personalized learning, and community engagement. By becoming a certified MWBE with the City of New York, we aim to further our mission of providing exceptional educational services and making a meaningful difference in the lives of students and families. We are excited to continue our journey of empowering students, supporting educators, and strengthening our community through education.

BrainBridge – Bridging the Gap to a Brighter Future in Education.

rows.business_description: Sweet Catch is more than just a restaurant; it’s a heartfelt mission led by a Black woman entrepreneur whose aim is to bring together her culture, flavor, and community. This seafood and soul food dining experience is deeply rooted in paying home age and the goal to have more representation, and ownership in the restaurant sector. With a focus on honoring tradition while pushing forward innovation, Sweet Catch delivers comfort food that warms the soul and reflects the vibrant culinary traditions of Black culture. At Sweet Catch, every detail is driven by a commitment to hospitality and community. The owner, a proud advocate for representation and empowerment, envisions a future where more Black-owned restaurants flourish across the country. The goal isn’t just to serve food but to nurture a culture of ownership and pride within marginalized communities. Sweet Catch aspires to be a beacon of opportunity, providing jobs, mentorship, and inspiration for others aspiring to enter the culinary and hospitality industries. The restaurant’s mission is simple yet powerful: ensure that everyone who walks through the doors feels valued and leaves with a satisfied heart and stomach. At Sweet Catch, the atmosphere is warm, inviting, and unapologetically authentic. Guests are treated like family, welcomed with the kind of genuine hospitality that’s rooted in Southern tradition but accessible to everyone. Whether it’s a first-time visitor or a loyal regular, each person is met with warmth and served dishes that are crafted with love. The menu is a vibrant blend of seafood staples and soul food classics, seasoned with the kind of spices and expertise that tell a story of heritage and passion. From shrimp and grits to collard greens, catfish to cornbread, each dish is a celebration of tradition reimagined with a modern twist. The fusion of flavors and textures reflects the diversity within Black culinary history, allowing guests to taste the richness of a culture that’s often underrepresented in mainstream food spaces. Sweet Catch isn’t just a restaurant; it’s a community hub. It’s a place where locals gather not just for the food but for the experience of togetherness. From hosting community events to offering pop-ups that highlight emerging Black chefs and food vendors, Sweet Catch aims to be a cornerstone of its neighborhood. The restaurant is designed to give back, reinvesting into the very communities it serves, with a focus on initiatives that promote economic empowerment, education, and arts. Looking forward, Sweet Catch has ambitions to expand into various markets across the country, spreading its mission of community-focused dining and Black ownership. The goal is to create a chain of Sweet Catch locations that each retain their local charm while sharing a unified vision. Each new opening is more than a business expansion; it’s an opportunity to plant the seeds of inclusion, representation, and community-building in new soil. As Sweet Catch grows, it remains committed to its core values: hospitality, community, and quality. With every plate served, the restaurant moves closer to fulfilling its mission—creating a space where everyone is seen, valued, and well-fed.

Described as “brilliant” and an “immense talent” (New York Magazine and Connect Savannah), Nicole is “redefining the very notion of classical music” (Atención San Miguel). Her credits range from the Guggenheim Museum (NYC), Rai Italia (Italy), and the Banff Centre (Canada) to Lincoln Center, Bellas Artes (Mexico), HBO, and the “underground” performances in Brooklyn factories and warehouses.


An awardee of the New York Foundation of the Arts (2024) and National Sawdust’s Hildegard Commission (2022 Finalist), Nicole has curated more than 100 productions featuring 200+ compositions and commissions over the last decade. Described as a “piano virtuoso” (The Daily Gazette, Saratoga Springs), Nicole focuses on the kinetic energy exchange in performances — with both her collaborators and her audience. Such collaborations range from .soundfullness — a salvaged piano installation that transforms outdoor spaces into places of deep listening — to partnering with artist/author Sam Morris in “wait-list-only” performances at actor Alan Cumming’s NYC Club.


A frequent guest presenter of workshops, master classes, and residencies, Nicole has delivered sessions for the Gesellschaftshaus Magdeburg, Germany; Lunigiana International Music Festival, Italy; for the Sphinx Organization; and for universities across the US. In 2022, she joined Seven Hills Chamber Music as Director and a distinguished Artist in Residence. She is a Yamaha Artist and a voting member of The Recording Academy (GRAMMYS), and her music is registered with ASCAP.

rows.business_description:
Irujo Inc. is an ISO 9001 and 17100 certified business specializing in translation and localization (adaptation for local audiences) of educational, technical, marketing, medical, corporate, and legal content into over 20 languages. Our expertise spans various published media, including digital, audiovisual and print formats, ensuring that content is tailored to resonate with global audiences.

We approach each project with a unique strategy, combining localization expertise, advanced language technologies, and computer-assisted translation (CAT) tools to maximize consistency, efficiency, and cost savings, particularly in large-scale projects with tight deadlines. Our process begins with a thorough understanding of the client’s needs, including the purpose, audience, and context of the translation. We collaborate with our clients to determine the best production approach—whether pure human translation, machine translation, or a blend of both—to meet their specific requirements and budget constraints.

In addition to translation, Irujo Inc. excels in desktop publishing, working directly within native authoring tools to ensure that localized documents retain their original design integrity. Our experienced desktop publishers handle the complexities of multilingual formatting, including text expansion, character encoding, and bidirectionality, adapting layouts to suit the target language and cultural context.

Irujo Inc. also specializes in eLearning localization. We localize a wide variety of eLearning content to enhance global training and education efforts, ensuring messages are conveyed effectively in the learner's native language. Our services support corporate training, compliance, safety, sales, product education, and more. Our comprehensive approach includes meticulous project planning, centralized project management, and the use of specialized eLearning and CAT tools, ensuring smooth integration of localized content. We partner with a global network of native-speaking linguists and professional voiceover talents to deliver content that reflects the nuances of the original, including tone, tempo, and cultural context. Our cultural adaptation services ensure terminology aligns with local regulations, and we provide guidance on adjusting visuals, colors, and other elements to suit the target audience.

Irujo Inc. also leverages Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Neural Machine Translation (NMT), a cutting-edge technology that significantly boosts productivity for large-scale translation projects. While NMT offers great efficiency, we assess each project individually to determine when and how to apply this technology. We integrate NMT with traditional CAT tools, Translation Memories, Term Bases, and Style Guides to enhance consistency and leverage historical translations effectively.

By combining advanced technology with human expertise, Irujo Inc. delivers high-quality, customized translations that meet the specific needs of our clients, optimizing workflows for unmatched speed and efficiency. Our commitment to quality and client satisfaction ensures that we bring significant value to every project, helping businesses communicate effectively across languages and cultures.

rows.business_description:
Founded in the wake of personal tragedy, Healing Inc. is not just a business but a beacon of hope, healing, and empowerment. The journey began after our founder, Isabel, experienced the heartbreaking loss of her brother to suicide. Faced with the overwhelming grief that comes from losing a loved one, Isabel found herself on a mission to spread awareness about mental health and the importance of self-care. It was during this period of reflection and healing that Healing Inc. was born—a company dedicated to promoting mental health awareness and providing an avenue for self-expression and self-care through the art of candle making.
At the core of Healing Inc. is a mission to spread mental health awareness and promote the practice of self-care. While candles are often seen as simple objects that add ambiance to a room, Healing Inc. has reimagined them as vessels for healing. Each candle-making workshop we conduct is an opportunity to not only craft a beautiful product but also to learn valuable lessons about mindfulness, self-compassion, and emotional well-being.

Our workshops are thoughtfully designed to blend creative expression with education about mental health. Each session provides participants with mental health tips, guidance on practicing self-care, and moments of introspection. Whether it’s discussing the importance of rest, sharing techniques for reducing anxiety, or simply holding space for individuals to talk about their mental health struggles, Healing Inc.’s workshops serve as a safe, supportive environment for healing and connection. Additionally, a portion of the proceeds from our candle sales go towards supporting suicide prevention programs and mental health organizations. By fostering these partnerships, we aim to create lasting change, helping individuals and communities as they navigate their mental health journeys.

rows.business_description:
I work as an independent curriculum and literacy consultant. As a curriculum consultant, I support teachers in designing and developing authentic, culturally responsive and sustaining, rigorous, standards-aligned curriculum across content areas, K-12. I also guide curriculum implementation by providing curriculum-aligned professional development, observing classroom teaching, and coaching teachers one-on-one and in small groups.

As a literacy consultant, I coach teachers to integrate literacy learning strategies into their existing curricula and instructional practice. I also conduct whole-school literacy program reviews. Guided by the principles of qualitative research, these program reviews include interviews with teachers and learners, targeted classroom observations, and curriculum and assessment review. I work with school leaders to develop protocols for the review and coordinating the interviews, observations, and document analysis. After conducting the review, I compile and analyze the data and develop a comprehensive literacy report that articulates key findings about the state of literacy teaching and learning in the school and supports them with anonymized data. I also offer recommendations for enhancing literacy teaching and learning in the coming years. After presenting the review, I work with school leaders to identify concrete short- and long-term steps for improvement.

rows.business_description:
Studio Elsa Ponce is a Brooklyn-based, full-service architecture and design firm specializing in community-driven projects. We bring expertise in co-creating community facilities and fostering inclusive engagement, offering services in both English and Spanish. Our interdisciplinary team delivers holistic solutions across architecture, interior design, furniture design, and graphic design, ensuring our clients experience seamless, 360° environments tailored to their needs, desires, and resources. 

Studio Elsa Ponce emerged from the belief that design should serve as a tool for social, environmental, and intergenerational equity. Inspired by the ethos of grassroots movements, we have developed a creative methodology grounded in solidarity and participation, that we adapt to the unique character of each community we serve.

We collaborate with change-making communities, nonprofits, and for-profit partners including the Workers Justice Project in Brooklyn and New Immigrant Community Empowerment (NICE) in Queens, to design culturally resonant spaces that cultivate connection and a sense of belonging. 

Our work has gained the support of organizations such as the New York State Council of the Arts (NYSCA), the Architectural League of New York, Mexico’s Endowment for the Arts (FONCA), Art Omi, and the Rema Hort Mann Foundation.

Elsa Ponce is a registered architect, educator, and founder of Studio Elsa Ponce. With a career spanning over fifteen years, Elsa has worked with award-winning design consultancies and architecture firms including Standard Issue, 2x4, Tatiana Bilbao Estudio, and TEN Arquitectos. Her portfolio spans various projects and locales, including cultural institutions, exhibitions, housing developments, and educational buildings across North America, the Caribbean, and East Asia.

Elsa has served as the Managing Director of Open Architecture Collaborative’s New York Chapter, a nonprofit organization that provides pro bono design services to underserved communities across New York City. She is a cohort member at the New Museum's NEW INC, the first museum-led cultural incubator. She teaches Professional Practice at the Spitzer School of Architecture at the City College of New York. Elsa also co-founded WIP Collaborative, a feminist practice working on projects that engage the public realm.

Elsa holds a bachelor's degree in architecture with honors from Universidad Iberoamericana in Mexico City and a Masters in Design Management from Pratt Institute in New York. She is a registered architect in New York State and Mexico.

Circle Up Learning was founded in 2023 to nurture relationships and provide opportunities to deepen restorative practices in schools. We all do our best learning when we feel seen, connected and valued; the experience of belonging drives students’ academic success. Circle Up Learning offers an experiential model for school staff, which considers belonging a practice we can learn and we can teach.  

Founder, Liz Howort, has facilitated and coached school staff for over 5 years across the 5 boroughs. In her prior life, Liz was the founding Director of the Bard Early College Academy (NYC), an academic enrichment program for middle school students. She also taught 9th grade ELA and supported learning in resource room for many years in District One. Raised by public school teachers, Liz witnessed how educators can uplift one another as they face a system that does not prioritize well-being. This insight led Liz to center social emotional learning (SEL) in her coaching work; she sustains teams by celebrating successes, finding strength in the collective, and co-planning to increase belonging. Liz brings an equity lens to all of her work, and has dived deep into racial equity and disability and inclusion. Liz is also passionate about personal storytelling, creative practices, and healing in community. Outside of school, she enjoys hikes, bikes and gardening with her family.  

Liz earned her BA and MAT from Bard College and her MFA from the New School University.

Founded by a passionate author dedicated to enriching the lives of children through literature, our mission extends beyond simply publishing books; we strive to create lasting experiences that foster a love for reading and learning in young minds.

Our platform serves as a valuable resource for parents seeking inspiration and practical tips for enriching their children's education outside of the classroom.

In addition to our literary offerings, we provide a curated selection of goods related to education and travel, further enhancing the learning experience for families. At Remy Raine Literature, we believe that the journey of learning is as important as the destination, and we are dedicated to empowering families to explore the world with their children.

As a minority women-owned business, we are driven by a commitment to inclusivity, creativity, and community engagement. We are excited to continue making a positive impact in the lives of children and families, one story at a time.

The DS Coaching & Consulting Group, DSCCG, is an executive coaching and leadership development organization that specializes in empowering senior leaders and executives to unlock their full potential. We offer 1:1 leadership coaching to new and emerging leaders, leadership development training - onsite & online, group coaching and team building initiatives.

With 30+ years of experience supporting top-level leadership and backed by ICF certification, we provide a unique and impactful approach to coaching. The focus is on helping leaders navigate the complexities of leadership, improve decision-making, and enhance their overall effectiveness, resulting in more robust, capable, and confident leaders and teams.

At the core is a personalized, results-oriented methodology that caters to the unique needs of each client. Offering one-on-one executive coaching that addresses critical aspects of leadership such as strategic thinking, emotional intelligence, communication, and conflict resolution. Whether a leader is transitioning into a new role, overseeing significant organizational change, or refining their leadership style, we tailor their coaching plan to help them thrive in their specific context. By partnering with clients in a deeply customized manner, we ensure that they not only address immediate challenges, but also develop the tools and mindset needed for sustained long-term success.

One of the key differentiators of our practice is the focus on helping leaders identify and overcome blind spots. Many senior leaders reach a point where they plateau, unable to see the limitations in their approach or mindset. We offer a safe, confidential space where leaders can reflect on their performance, explore their strengths, and work through obstacles that may be holding them back. Through guided introspection and actionable feedback, we partner with clients to break through these barriers, allowing them to lead with greater confidence, clarity, and impact.

DSCCG also emphasizes leadership transitions. New leaders face unique challenges when stepping into executive roles, and our coaching helps them accelerate their success. By guiding them through the nuances of their new responsibilities, they are empowered to establish a clear vision, build strong teams, and foster the credibility needed to succeed. Our coaching process provides both the support and the accountability required for leaders to thrive in new environments, ensuring they are equipped to drive their organizations forward from day one.

In addition to one-on-one coaching, we also offer organizational leadership development programs. These programs are designed to help organizations integrate coaching as part of their broader talent development strategy. Whether through group coaching sessions, leadership workshops, or initiatives to build internal coaching capabilities, we partner with organizations to strengthen their leadership pipeline and foster a culture of continuous growth and development. We understand the dynamics of organizational success and the importance of aligning leadership development with broader business objectives, which allows us to design impactful programs that drive lasting change.

A cornerstone of our business is the 90-day executive leadership coaching program, specifically designed to support new leaders as they transition into executive positions. The program provides a structured yet adaptable framework for leadership development, focusing on key areas such as vision setting, strategic decision-making, team leadership, and fostering alignment with organizational objectives. Throughout the 90-day program we emphasize the importance of leveraging internal resources, ensuring that leaders have a support system in place to maximize their impact and sustain their success long-term.

Our approach to coaching is both practical and insightful. We guide leaders through difficult decisions, help them cultivate self-awareness, and push them to take ownership of their growth. The coaching relationship is built on trust and collaboration, with an emphasis on achieving specific, measurable outcomes. By focusing on tangible results, we ensure that clients not only develop as leaders but also deliver meaningful contributions to their organizations.

Moreover, our focus on integrating internal coaching skills within organizations highlights the long-term value DSCCG provides. Businesses recognize the importance of creating an internal coaching culture, training leaders to support each other, and embedding continuous development as part of the organizational fabric. This approach ensures that leadership growth is sustainable and that coaching benefits extend beyond individual sessions into the organization's day-to-day practices. 

Ultimately, the DS Coaching & Consulting Group is the trusted partner for leaders and organizations seeking to enhance their leadership capabilities and drive long-term success.

rows.business_description:
Nova Tech, LLC is a value-added distributor of NYS and NYC standard traffic signal and electrical products, as well as the exclusive distributor of custom-designed LED products. As a certified DBE company, Nova Tech can provide value-added products and services to satisfy the customer’s needs. I devote 40+ hours a week to developing and growing this business by determining market needs, creating contacts through making sales calls, attending ITS meetings, email marketing, and developing manufacturer relationships. 

Nova Tech is the exclusive dealer for several companies that can provide MUTCD-approved signage, such as LED Blankout signs, Lane Control Signals, and custom signage for bus stop applications. We have developed proposals and specifications for NYC DOT to provide a retrofit solution for their damaged Wayfinding and RTPI bus signs located throughout the five boroughs, and placed 40 retrofit kit units in the city this year. The signage can display the time until arrival, and the “Smarts” of the product pulls the data feed from the MTA BUS TIME system to display and annunciate the information for each route. 

Nova Tech works with its customers to determine areas of need in their electrical and VMS systems and develops solutions through retrofit development of the damaged parts. These retrofit solutions are cost-efficient for the agency in need as it is a fraction of the cost of a new sign, and time-efficient for the technician who is replacing it.  
 
We are also the northeast distributor of street lighting controls via TRAFFIXLINX software. Sitting on top of this standard lighting control application, we can provide specialized applications that have cameras with analytics to monitor stopped vehicles, double-parked vehicles, vehicle counts, and pedestrian monitoring. Other applications include air quality measurements and speed monitoring. We provide and manage annual service agreements for our customers and customize the software based on their needs. 

Additionally, Nova Tech supplies and distributes electrical, ITS, and traffic equipment for contractors throughout the state and country. We store product in our warehouse and ship the product using our own truck. We create proposals and estimates. We manage inventory through purchase orders and store material in our warehouse. We release and distribute material as needed. We provide all invoicing and certificates required, depending on the requirements of the project.

rows.business_description: My name is PercyLee Anderson, I`m the middle child of five siblings. I was born in the early 60`s during the end of the civil rights movement. I grew up in a time when children respected and greeted their elders. Values, Courtesy, Manners and Respect were a way of life.  It was a set of standards, that were passed down, taught, given and shared from generation to generation.  We were hit with two epidemics in the 80`s, Crack and HIV. A generation got lost, and along with that Values, Courtesy, Manners and Respect were lost too, but not for all.  A negative environment arose through the 80`s, 90`s, into the present and spread from the young to the old.  Me and a partner would discuss issues concerning the values and how they were lost and how they needed to be revived and brought back.  We wrote a few books, that covered some of these issues.  Then after a few years, I sat down and continued to write more on the basic with my first publication, People Learning Everyday Etiquette. Just to get people ( young and old) thinking and behaving in a correct manner. Then I decided to go deeper, it wasn`t just how people acted, it was on how some thought, and like I said from the young to the old.  That’s when I wrote, Positive Learning Equates Etiquette. It’s not only teaching, its reteaching, it`s directing and redirecting, it`s suggesting a better choice and lifestyle that once was, could be again for all. Soft Skills Training. Book Author. NYC Borough Map T-shirts. Personal Etiquette and Manners Books your youth and adults.

Whether it’s developing a comprehensive strategy to support a real estate expansion project in the community or managing the community board or government agency landscape regarding a specific client issue, The Brinn Group’s experienced team of professionals work with their clients to realize their goals and objectives. The Brinn Group has worked with some of the largest nonprofit healthcare, social services and housing development organizations, industry coalitions, elected officials and developers in New York and across the Tri-State area.

Business Development
With our deep subject matter expertise and thought leadership, The Brinn Group is the partner to help you implement your high-level business strategies so you can expand into the market, grow and achieve success. Since 2004, The Brinn Group – formerly Fernando Brinn & Associates – has been providing strategic business advice, political and economic risk analysis, and community and cultural know-how to national and local corporations and nonprofit businesses.
Whether it’s identifying potential business partners and funders to support your growth plans, providing assistance with developing proposals for regulatory agencies, or serving as a liaison with government entities, elected officials or community boards to secure project approval, The Brinn Group has your back. Our team can customize a unique approach to meet the needs of your organization and create a process that also works for your stakeholders. We will develop an end-to-end business solution that will help your organization achieve its immediate and long-term objectives.

Real Estate Consulting
The Brinn Group recognizes that every real estate project has the potential for unforeseen challenges and those issues can be compounded when expansion, relocation or renovation is for a nonprofit organization or planned for historically underserved communities. For over seven years, the Brinn Group has been a trusted advocate for many nonprofit and for profit organizations, in the greater NYC area, including some of the leading healthcare, social services and housing development organizations in the community, helping to spearhead the development of real estate projects that bring the organization’s vision to life. Whether it’s identifying potential properties for acquisition, finding the right financial and business deal partner(s) to support an expansion project, or getting local community buy-in, the Brinn team can guide and protect your organization’s goals and objectives throughout every step of the project.

Community Relations and Coalition Building
The Brinn leadership has over seventeen years counseling, advocating, developing and implementing community relations and network coalition building strategies for some of the region’s largest and most successful companies and employers. Brinn clients benefit from years of experience mobilizing grassroots support to influence decision makers and achieve policy goals. The Brinn team has the ability to identify and bring together key stakeholders, merge competing agendas and organize win-win messaging that is on point for all parties. Our network of professionals and alliances gives us the edge to efficiently and effectively design and build grassroots coalitions that positively impact your business.

Communications, Marketing and Community Events
The Brinn Group provides quality expertise and management services for all types of community outreach and brand building events, such as health fairs, food drives, and neighborhood block parties, just to name a few. The professionals at The Brinn Group have proficient skills in event planning and management, to ensure that each and every aspect of your event is provided for. Our team can develop and implement innovative digital (online and social media) and grassroots communication and marketing strategies that will properly educate the community about your vision and goals for the community at large. Through the design and implementation of strategic outreach events and the deployment of targeted marketing resources, The Brinn Group can help your organization reach a wider base of support for your projects, and position your company as a trusted member of the business community.

Located in the heart of the Bronx, Boston Road Lock Hardware LLC is a trusted, minority-owned locksmith service provider offering a full range of residential and commercial locksmithing solutions. Our licensed locksmith combines advanced technological tools with classic manual methods to ensure your security needs are met with precision, reliability, and expertise. Serving businesses, government facilities, schools, healthcare institutions, and private properties, we specialize in high-security systems, including access control solutions, high-tech locking mechanisms, and emergency services. Whether you need to secure a government building, install a master key system for a commercial complex, or handle a lockout at your office, Boston Road Lock Hardware LLC is equipped to provide secure, efficient solutions.
  
At Boston Road Lock Hardware LLC, we understand the unique security challenges that large-scale businesses and institutions face. We provide expert installation, repair, and maintenance of commercial-grade locking systems that ensure both protection and ease of access. Our services include the installation of high-security locks, from traditional deadbolts to advanced electronic access control systems, providing reliable protection against unauthorized access, tampering, and break-ins. We also design and implement master key systems, allowing businesses to streamline access to multiple areas while maintaining strict control over who can enter specific zones. In addition to traditional lock and key services, we offer state-of-the-art access control solutions, including keyless entry systems, card readers, and biometric locks, enabling businesses to manage access to secure areas with a focus on efficiency and scalability.
  
We specialize in rekeying and key duplication services for a wide variety of commercial locks. Whether you need to rekey a single door or rekey an entire building, Boston Road Lock Hardware LLC has the experience and tools to carry out the job quickly and effectively. Our high-quality key duplication services are ideal for businesses that require precise, durable keys for everyday use. Additionally, we offer comprehensive lockout services for both commercial and fleet vehicles, ensuring that employees and business owners can quickly regain access to their properties or vehicles in the event of a lockout. We also install, maintain, and repair safes and vaults, from small commercial safes to large-scale vault doors, ensuring that your sensitive documents and valuables are kept secure at all times.
  
For institutions that require compliance with building safety regulations, we provide expert services for panic hardware and emergency exit systems, including the installation and maintenance of push bars, emergency exit alarms, and door closers. These systems are crucial for ensuring the safety of occupants in the event of emergencies, while also meeting local fire and safety codes. In addition, we offer comprehensive door hardware installation and repair, including specialized locks for filing cabinets, desks, and interior doors, along with a full range of commercial locks, deadbolts, and keyless systems.
   
At Boston Road Lock Hardware LLC, we are committed to delivering the highest level of security for your property. Whether you're looking to upgrade your security systems, require routine lock maintenance, or need immediate assistance with an emergency lockout situation, our skilled locksmith is ready to serve. We take pride in delivering prompt, reliable service that is consistently focused on customer satisfaction. Our mobile locksmith units are fully equipped to handle on-site requests, allowing us to serve all five boroughs of New York City and surrounding areas quickly and efficiently.
  
With our locksmith’s decades of experience in the locksmithing industry, we are a trusted partner for businesses and homeowners alike. Our team is continuously trained on the latest locksmithing technologies and techniques, ensuring we can address the most complex security challenges. Whether you need to secure a high-traffic commercial building, install a sophisticated access control system, or simply replace a lock, Boston Road Lock Hardware LLC is your go-to locksmith service provider.

rows.business_description:
JoyTutor, a minority/woman-owned business founded by JoAnna Williams, empowers individuals, especially those from underserved communities, to achieve personal and professional success. With over 19 years of experience in project management, JoAnna’s journey from overcoming significant personal challenges to becoming a successful entrepreneur exemplifies resilience and empowerment.

Mission & Vision:
JoyTutor’s mission is to help individuals unlock their potential, drive business growth, and create lasting impact through coaching, strategic project management, and empowerment events. The vision is to build generational wealth and success for individuals and organizations, particularly within marginalized communities.

Services Offered:

Youth Empowerment Coaching: Tailored programs to help high school and college students develop leadership, academic confidence, and resilience.

Project Management Consulting: JoAnna’s expertise in managing large-scale projects, including portfolio management, risk and financial management, and stakeholder engagement, is offered to organizations.

Empowerment Events: JoyTutor’s Celebrations of Courage Award and Brunch honors individuals for personal and entrepreneurial growth, providing inspiration and fostering community.

Business Development Services: JoyTutor provides business development services, offering personalized classes and one-on-one coaching to help entrepreneurs overcome obstacles and align their actions with their goals. Through tailored coaching, we support clients in unlocking their potential and achieving success.

Personal Journey and Leadership:

JoAnna’s journey includes overcoming adversity as a third-generation teen mother, becoming the first in her family to graduate high school, and achieving multiple degrees while raising her children. Her resilience has earned her recognition, including the Ruth Snyder Individual Achievement Award from the U.S. House of Representatives.

Impact & Track Record:

JoAnna’s work spans various industries, having successfully managed multi-million-dollar projects for clients like American Express and Teach For America. She has helped numerous clients unlock their potential, combining her project management expertise with her passion for personal development.

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:

As a minority/woman-owned business, JoAnna is committed to promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion, ensuring that underserved communities have access to resources and opportunities for success.

Conclusion:

With extensive experience, a strong commitment to empowerment, and a passion for personal growth, JoyTutor offers coaching, strategic planning, and empowerment services to create pathways for success for individuals and organizations alike.

rows.business_description:
Established in 2012, ClearlyEnergy specializes in climate policy analysis, climate program management, and software development. ClearlyEnergy, an 80% women-owned certified small business, works at the nexus of public policy and software solutions using data-driven analytics and reporting to enable the energy transition. We are uniquely qualified to facilitate residential and commercial building energy programs through personalized policy development and implementation support. Our projects include benchmarking and building performance standards, carbon accounting and disclosure, energy-efficient mortgages, virtual residential audits, and automated energy models. ClearlyEnergy’s suite of software solutions are designed to facilitate emissions reduction programs in a streamlined and equitable manner.

Residential
ClearlyEnergy works with community partners to add transparency to home energy costs and manage both voluntary and compliance residential energy disclosure programs. ClearlyEnergy developed the Automated Energy Model and the Remotely app to help homeowners complete and review a residential energy audit of their home.  This information helps the current, or future, homeowners understand their home’s energy costs, consumption, and emissions and can help lenders screen candidate homes for energy mortgages. 

Commercial
ClearlyEnergy is a thought leader in the field of building performance standards. Our proprietary software, Building Energy Analysis Manager (BEAM), aggregates benchmarking data and performs automatic compliance tracking based on a jurisdiction's specific benchmarking or building performance standards policy. BEAM was developed by leveraging partnerships with the EPA, DOE, and National Labs to ensure we created a forward-thinking energy solution. BEAM is used by a diverse selection of state and local jurisdictions across the country that range in size, bandwidth, and implementation starting points. 

Targeted Projects
ClearlyEnergy uses its skills and capabilities with software development, energy modeling, stakeholder engagement, training, research and analysis, program management, and technical assistance to support states, jurisdictions, and organizations in their targeted energy efficiency projects and policy development and implementation. Examples of specific projects include supporting West Virginia in the creation of an inter-agency energy and water use data communication tool; supporting Cambridge, MA in tracking building compliance towards their goal of achieving carbon neutrality in buildings; developing and maintaining, for Northeast Energy Efficiency Partnerships (NEEP), the Home Energy Labeling Information eXchange (HELIX) database that populates real estate listings with home energy information; developing the software for NEEP’s Cold Climate Air Source Heat Pump List (ASHP) and supplemental sizing and visualization tools; and providing energy burden analyses and greenhouse gas disclosure to financial institutions to support residential loans.

rows.business_description:
Generation Verb is a transformative youth empowerment program that uses the art of spoken word poetry to inspire greatness, foster literacy, and build confidence among students.  Generation Verb is committed to creating a culture of self-expression, collaboration, and personal growth within schools and communities. The program’s mission is rooted in a simple yet profound belief: young people are greater than they think they are and possess the power to shape their lives and the world around them. 

 At its core, Generation Verb combines performance poetry with workshops and competitions to create a dynamic and engaging environment where students can discover their voices. The program encourages participants to explore their thoughts, feelings, and experiences through writing and performing original poetry. By doing so, it helps students develop critical literacy skills, creative thinking, and a deep appreciation for the power of words. More importantly, it instills in them a sense of responsibility for the lasting impact their words can have.  

Generation Verb’s workshops are carefully designed to integrate literary devices, creative writing techniques, and performance skills. These sessions provide students with the tools to craft meaningful poetry while enhancing their cognitive abilities and emotional intelligence. The program emphasizes self-discovery, teamwork, and overcoming barriers, ensuring that every participant leaves with a stronger sense of self and purpose.

The Write Speak Inspire League (WSIL), Generation Verb’s signature competitive poetry league, adds an exciting dimension to the program. Students participate in team-based matches where they perform surrounded by a supportive audience. These competitions challenge students to refine their skills, build confidence under pressure, and celebrate the art of spoken word in a collaborative setting.

Ultimately, Generation Verb is more than a poetry program—a movement. It seeks to create a pipeline to great possibilities in professional performance, education, or other fields. By empowering students to express themselves responsibly and confidently, Generation Verb ensures its participants are prepared to lead, inspire, and achieve greatness in all they do.

Through its innovative approach to education and self-expression, Generation Verb continues to transform lives, one verse at a time.

Our capabilities span industrial and MRO supply, technology and electronics, bulk materials, logistics, facilities support, and disaster recovery.

Industrial & MRO Supply: We source and supply a broad range of maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) products through established wholesale distributor relationships. Our industrial supply catalog includes hardware, fasteners, tools and hand tools, power tools, abrasives, adhesives, lubricants, electrical components, plumbing and HVAC supplies, safety equipment, janitorial and facility maintenance materials, and other general industrial supplies. We support procurement needs across construction, infrastructure maintenance, manufacturing, and facilities operations for government and commercial clients.

Technology & Electronics: We supply IT hardware, networking equipment, servers and storage, audio-visual systems, point-of-sale and data capture technology, semiconductors, passive and active electronic components, and related accessories and peripherals. Our wholesale supply relationships span the full spectrum of technology distribution, from enterprise IT infrastructure to component-level procurement. We support technology refresh, equipment deployment, and infrastructure buildouts for agencies and contractors.

Ice & Water Supply: We supply block ice, cubed ice, dry ice, and bulk packaged ice for research, scientific, commercial, industrial, and emergency applications. We also supply bulk bottled water. These capabilities support food service operations, industrial cooling, transportation, and emergency response activations.

Bulk Materials: We supply aggregates, construction sand and gravel, concrete, road salt, and de-icing materials for construction, water treatment, road maintenance, and industrial applications.

Logistics & Transportation: We provide general and specialized freight transport, commercial moving, packing and crating, and ground logistics support. Services include equipment relocation, heavy freight coordination, warehousing and storage, and last-mile delivery.

Equipment Rental: We provide heavy machinery and equipment rentals to support facilities maintenance, infrastructure projects, and construction and demolition operations.

Disaster Recovery & Emergency Supply: We supply bulk water, ice, and dry ice to support emergency response and disaster recovery operations, including municipal and federal emergency management activations. Our logistics capabilities enable rapid deployment and sustained supply in time-sensitive situations.

Firearms, Ammunition & Tactical Supply: GPN Partners holds a Federal Firearms License (FFL) and is a NYS-licensed ammunition dealer. We supply firearms, ammunition, firearm accessories and tactical gear to authorized government purchasers in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local law.

rows.business_description:
We are a fully insured, woman-owned equipment rental provider serving the construction sector throughout Suffolk County, Long Island, and the five boroughs of New York City. Our company specializes in supplying modern, well-maintained dump trucks and hauling equipment to contractors, developers, and construction firms.

We provide reliable equipment rentals to support a wide range of construction activities. Our trucks support clients with material transport, logistics, and job site operations. This includes moving excavation materials such as dirt, broken concrete, and asphalt, as well as mulch, clean fill, topsoil, asphalt millings, salt, DOT-approved RCA, custom gravel blends, and all sizes of stone.

Our fleet is fully insured and equipped with BIC plates, allowing operation throughout New York City and Long Island. We prioritize reliability, safety, and punctuality, ensuring our equipment is ready to meet our clients’ project demands.
As an equipment rental provider, we supply the necessary hauling equipment; all operators, drivers, and construction services are provided directly by our clients.

In addition to the clarification above, Destinee is only under contract with DTA for the following reasons: 

DTA rents my equipment because I provide reliable, fully insured, and properly registered dump trucks ready for construction and hauling operations. Maintaining this type of equipment is expensive, requiring insurance, permits, registrations, compliance, and upkeep. Therefore, it is more efficient for companies to rent equipment as needed rather than own and maintain additional trucks themselves.
My company’s role is to provide the equipment for their projects and operations. DTA controls the job sites, scope of work, and drivers operating the equipment. We supply the trucks/equipment so they can complete their construction and material hauling needs efficiently and without delays.

rows.business_description:
GameGlory is an esports entertainment and education company that operates at the intersection of competitive gaming, workforce development, and community empowerment. The business designs and delivers immersive, talent-driven interactive experiences that elevate both gameplay and personal growth. GameGlory runs a structured esports league with biweekly seasonal live matchups, and team-based competition across popular titles such as Call of Duty, Smash Bros., Tekken, Street Fighter, and more. The company helps its players improve both in-game strategy and out-of-game life skills by offering training in communication, content creation, team building, and digital literacy, often in partnership with workforce organizations, schools, and nonprofits.

Our programming is rooted in a belief that gaming is a powerful platform for connection, identity, and future readiness. We use esports and other interactive entertainment as a lens to introduce youth, young adults & adults to careers in technology, marketing, event production, broadcasting, and entrepreneurship. In doing so, GameGlory transforms casual gamers into purpose-driven competitors and creators.

Key offerings include:

GameGlory Esports League: A structured, seasonal competition featuring rotating matchups, performance incentives, and media coverage.

GameGlory Labs: Workshops and digital training programs focused on gaming careers, live streaming, branding, and community management.

GameGlory Performance Hub: A digital platform for tracking player progress, match stats, and goal-setting metrics, creating visibility for sponsors and scouts.

Talent Development & Recruitment: We identify and cultivate emerging gaming talent, offering pathways into local tournaments, professional scenes, and digital entrepreneurship.

GameGlory also champions equity and representation in esports. We center Black and Brown gamers, foster gender inclusion, and collaborate with mission-aligned partners to ensure accessibility. Whether it's hosting a tournament, co-producing a music-and-gaming showcase, or delivering career exposure workshops, we intentionally build spaces where culture, competition, and community collide.

Looking ahead, GameGlory is poised to scale our league model into new cities, partner with more gaming lounges and CBOs, and integrate web-based tools for broader reach. We’re also actively developing sponsorship opportunities and industry partnerships to fuel our next stage of growth.

GameGlory is where gamers compete, grow, and evolve. Our vision is clear: to make competitive gaming a launchpad for life success—both on and off the screen.

rows.business_description:
Brighther is an MWBE-certified management consulting/professional services, coaching, and training firm serving New York City agencies, nonprofit organizations, employers, and workforce development partners. Founded by a current PhD candidate in AI, Columbia-certified executive coach and ICF-credentialed leader with 15+ years at EY and Boeing, Brighther delivers inclusive solutions that build organizational capacity. We provide services in 3 areas: Training, Leadership Development and Coaching, AI, Technology & Organizational Consulting, and Neurodiversity Inclusion, Hiring and Disability Support. 

Leadership Development, Training & Coaching
Brighther provides executive, leadership, and career coaching with specialized expertise in women's leadership and advancement, and coaching leaders through AI disruption, organizational change, and periods of transition and uncertainty. Programs include cohort-based leadership development, 360-degree leadership assessments using Hogan and NBI instruments, individualized development plans, succession planning, mentoring program design, and performance management strategy. Facilitation of management retreats and workshops, Training and workforce development offerings include instructor-led training (non-technical), workshop facilitation, AI training and AI literacy programs, DEI and workplace inclusion training, professional skills development, job readiness, and workforce transition programming. Additional capabilities include curriculum development, instructional design, train-the-trainer programs, upskilling and reskilling initiatives, and onboarding program design for public agencies, nonprofits, and employers.

Technology & Organizational Consulting
Brighther provides management consulting and organizational development services including current state assessments, capital planning feasibility assessments and strategic assessments, strategic planning, business process analysis and redesign, change management, requirements definition, stakeholder engagement, and program design. Technology consulting services include IT change management, technology process design, digital transformation readiness, go-live support, UAT, post-implementation stabilization, and operating model design for key systems including Microsoft, ServiceNow and SAP. 
We are certified in AI transformations and also provide support with AI readiness assessments and governance framework development, AI change adoption strategy and execution. Additional capabilities include government consulting, policy and program analysis, portfolio management, interagency coordination, and human capital management strategy. 

Neurodiversity Inclusion & Disability Employment
Brighther provides neurodiversity inclusion consulting and disability employment services for employers, HR teams, and public agencies. Services include neuroinclusion strategy, neurodiversity hiring program design, inclusive interviewing practices, reasonable accommodations guidance, disability etiquette training, and manager and team training on supporting employees with ADHD, autism spectrum disorder (ASD), dyslexia, and other cognitive differences. Brighther also delivers pre-employment transition services (Pre-ETS), work readiness training, life skills programming, and employment preparation curricula for individuals with disabilities, including programming aligned to ITPs and IEPs. Additional services include ERG facilitation, psychologically safe team culture development, disability inclusion policy consulting, and workforce needs assessments — grounded in both professional expertise and lived experience as a LEND graduate, awarded certificate by ACRE, and parent of a child with autism.
Brighther serves NYC agencies, nonprofits, educational institutions, and employers citywide,  bringing a transformation-led, equity-centered approach to consulting, coaching, AI enablement, and workforce inclusion.

rows.business_description:
Inspirlang offers high quality online and in-person language classes designed for non-native and heritage speakers of different Chinese dialects such as Cantonese, Mandarin, and Taishanese/Toisan. Each course comes with an exclusive physical and digital textbook designed by Inspirlang. The textbook is suitable for each student’s level, ranging from beginners (Levels 1&2), upper beginners (Levels 3&4), intermediate learners (Levels 5&6), to more advanced speakers (conversational classes). Throughout our classes, our students will get exposed to Cantonese conversations, grammar, pop cultures and current events. In each class, students get to learn to use and get familiarized with the standard romanization system, along with reading and writing commonly known characters. As students enjoy a conversational class in an ideal group size of eight students per class, they also get equipped to move on to the next level to advance their Chinese skills. 

In addition to live content, Inspirlang also produces podcasts and videos to teach Chinese. For beginners to intermediate level learners, podcasts of short-lengths such as "Learn Cantonese Daily," "Learn Mandarin Daily," and "Learn Taishanese Daily" are digestible and perfect to build new vocabulary and sentence structures. For intermediate and advanced learners, "Boba Break Cantonese," "Cantonese Diaspora," and "Taishanese Diaspora" provide grammar breakdown and spontaneous conversations. Other than audio content like podcasts, students also enjoy watching tutorial and vlog videos to bring their Chinese level to the next step as they review the transcript packages of Inspirlang’s media content.

Inspirlang also publishes accredited language instructional books such as "Learn to Speak Cantonese" 1&2, "Learn to Speak Mandarin 1," "Learn to Speak Taishanese 1," and "Journaling in Chinese." Each one of Inspirlang’s textbooks comes with a unique storyline to create organic conversions built by commonly used vocabulary and sentence structures to create a more fun learning experience. Inspirlang’s bookstore is full of surprises that students will always find something helpful to their Chinese studying, including our line of stationeries!

rows.business_description:
Stacy BE Photography is a full-service photography company where I specialize in corporate events, and portrait photography. I built this business on the belief that photography is more than images it is a powerful tool for empowerment, storytelling, and transformation.

Over the years, I have had the honor of working with a diverse portfolio of clients, from Fortune 500 companies to grassroots nonprofits. My corporate partnerships include Tiffany & Co., Louis Vuitton, Ernst & Young LLP, Hennessy, and City Harvest. I provide executive and team headshots, corporate event coverage, brand activations, and creative projects that align with each client’s goals and brand identity. My reputation is built on professionalism, reliability, and the ability to deliver imagery that creates lasting impact.

What makes Stacy BE Photography unique is the way I combine corporate excellence with a deep commitment to community engagement. I developed my own C.A.P.T.U.R.E. Framework—Cultivate Inner Greatness, Awaken Self-Love, Photograph Unique Beauty, Transformative Journey, Unveil Self-Love, Radiate Confidence, and Elevate Empowerment. This framework guides my work and ensures that every client experience is more than a session; it is a journey of empowerment.

Serving my community is at the heart of my business. I created ShutterFly: Empowering Girls Through Photography, a mentorship program that provides underrepresented girls of color with cameras, skills training, and mentorship. The program culminates in public exhibits and a published photography book that showcases their talents. I also partner with nonprofits such as 100Suits, where I provide professional portraits to individuals reentering the workforce, helping them step into new opportunities with confidence. Additionally, I have developed projects that glamorize people with both visible and invisible disabilities, using imagery to honor their dignity and ensure representation.

Through this work, I have seen firsthand how photography changes lives. My lens has allowed me to empower individuals, uplift communities, and create opportunities for self-expression and confidence. At the same time, I bring the same precision, creativity, and excellence to my corporate clients, ensuring their events, branding, and leadership teams are represented at the highest level.

My vision for Stacy BE Photography is to continue growing as both a creative service provider and a community partner. I aim to expand my reach by building long-term partnerships, pursuing government and municipal contracts, creating economic opportunities, and scaling programs that use photography as a tool for empowerment.

In every setting whether capturing a luxury brand event or leading a grassroots initiative I remain committed to excellence, innovation, and service. Stacy BE Photography is not just a business; it is a mission to transform how people see themselves and how the world sees them.

*Hidden Gems Solutions** is a consulting firm that partners with schools, government agencies, nonprofits, and corporations to unlock their full potential through strategic innovation, smart systems, and inclusive community engagement. Our mission is to help mission-driven organizations operate more efficiently, reach their target audiences more effectively, and build meaningful connections using tools that are practical, accessible, and sustainable.

Founded by Natasha Green — an educator, entrepreneur, and national community strategist — Hidden Gems Solutions was created to bridge the gap between vision and execution. With over a decade of experience leading transformative programs in both public and private sectors, Natasha brings deep expertise in education, technology, systems design, and stakeholder engagement.

We specialize in delivering high-impact solutions that reduce overwhelm, enhance productivity, and drive community-centered outcomes. Our work spans across industries and is rooted in the belief that the right strategy, paired with the right tools, can create ripple effects of change.

**Core Services Include:**

- **AI & Automation Integration**  
  From schools to city departments to corporate teams, we teach organizations how to integrate assistive intelligence tools to automate workflows, reduce repetitive tasks, and increase engagement — without losing the human touch.

- **Digital Presence & Communication Strategy**  
  We help institutions update their websites, refine messaging, align social media, and build systems that reflect their values, communicate clearly, and connect consistently with their communities.

- **Strategic Planning & Operational Support**  
  Our 90-day strategy cycles and customized consulting packages offer hands-on support to assess current systems, improve internal operations, and implement people-first processes that scale.

- **Customized Trainings & Workshops**  
  We design and deliver workshops for educators, government staff, and company teams focused on innovation, tech adoption, equity, and leadership. Topics range from digital transformation and stakeholder engagement to AI fluency and team alignment.

- **Community Engagement & Family Involvement Solutions**  
  We create systems and strategies that ensure families, residents, and stakeholders aren’t just informed — they’re involved. Our approach supports long-term trust, transparency, and collaboration.

What sets Hidden Gems Solutions apart is our ability to serve as a **translator between sectors** — understanding the needs of educators, the priorities of government entities, and the pace of corporate innovation. Our cross-sector lens allows us to design solutions that are agile, mission-aligned, and rooted in impact.

We’ve supported over 300 programs and events globally, helped school districts modernize their communication systems, collaborated with civic agencies to improve community outreach, and guided corporate teams in deploying tech tools that save time and boost morale.

Whether you're launching a new initiative, modernizing your operations, or building stronger relationships with your stakeholders, Hidden Gems Solutions is the partner you need to move forward — smarter, faster, and with clarity.

rows.business_description:
Workshop for Architecture (WFORA), established in 2003 and based in the Bronx, New York, is a multidisciplinary architecture and design firm known for its integrated approach to design and construction. The firm has undertaken a diverse range of projects, varying in scale and type, guided by core principles that emphasize client collaboration, economic feasibility, sustainability, and a unique design-build methodology. 

DESIGN PHILOSOPHY
WFORA's design philosophy centers on establishing clear yet flexible design intentions in collaboration with clients. This approach ensures that decisions, down to the finest details, align with the overarching vision of each project. By maintaining flexibility, the firm allows room for inspiration and innovation throughout the design process, resulting in spaces that are both functional and aesthetically pleasing.

ECONOMIC CONSIDERATIONS

Understanding the importance of budget in any project, WFORA designs with a keen awareness of economic constraints. The firm evaluates whether additional costs provide tangible value to the client, ensuring that every investment enhances the overall quality and functionality of the space. This pragmatic approach balances fiscal responsibility with design excellence.

SUSTAINABILITY COMMITTMENT
Sustainability is a cornerstone of WFORA's practice. The firm believes that environmentally conscious design not only benefits the planet but also creates healthier and more enjoyable spaces for clients. By integrating sustainable materials and energy-efficient systems, WFORA designs spaces that are both responsible and responsive to environmental concerns.

DESIGN-BUILD INTEGRATION
A distinguishing feature of WFORA is its integration of design and construction services. Through its sister company, Workshop for Construction, the firm offers a seamless design-build process. This integration fosters better communication, streamlined project management, and cohesive execution, resulting in projects that are aesthetically cohesive and economically efficient. 

TEAM AND EXPERTISE
The WFORA team comprises professionals with diverse backgrounds in architecture, interiors, urban planning, construction, development, sustainability, and strategic planning. Each member brings their unique perspectives and expertise to the firm's projects which help develop the best results for clients.

PROJECT PORTFOLIO
Over the years, WFORA has developed a varied portfolio that includes residential, commercial, developers, public and master planning projects. The firm's work is characterized by a commitment to contextually responsive design, attention to detail, and a balance between innovation and tradition. By tailoring each project to its specific context and client needs, WFORA creates spaces that are both unique and enduring.

CLIENT & COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT
WFORA places a strong emphasis on client and community engagement, recognizing the importance of designing spaces that resonate with and serve the people and communities in which they are situated. The firm actively seeks input from stakeholders and incorporates users' feedback into the design process, ensuring that projects are inclusive and reflective of the client and larger community values.

CONCLUSION
Workshop for Architecture stands out as a firm that seamlessly blends design innovation with practical execution. Through its client-centered approach, economic mindfulness, sustainability commitment, and integrated design-build model, WFORA delivers projects that are not only visually compelling but also functional and environmentally responsible. With a dedicated team and a diverse portfolio, the firm continues to make significant contributions to the architectural landscape of New York and beyond.
